title: Image Patch Tensor Axis Reordering
prompt:
Implement `patchify_channels_first(image, patch_height, patch_width)` using NumPy. `image` is a numeric, three-dimensional array with shape `(height, width, channels)` for one HWC image. Divide it into non-overlapping patches of size `patch_height` by `patch_width`, without padding or resizing. Both image dimensions must be exactly divisible by their corresponding patch dimensions.

Return an array with shape `(height // patch_height, width // patch_width, channels, patch_height, patch_width)`. The first two axes preserve raster order of the patches, and the channel axis must precede the two within-patch spatial axes. In particular, for every valid index `r`, `c`, `channel`, `i`, and `j`, the result must satisfy `result[r, c, channel, i, j] == image[r * patch_height + i, c * patch_width + j, channel]`. Preserve the input dtype and do not mutate `image`.

Raise `ValueError` when `image` is not a numeric three-dimensional NumPy array, any image dimension is zero, either patch dimension is not a positive integer, or the patch dimensions do not divide the image height and width exactly.
